sources: Hits, frames, keys, events, stagger, energy, the Final Strike, the finisher factors and the Knock Downs: rmxlinux Json/SkillData chr_0015_lifeng_* (game 1.6) as compiled by efsim kit-draft (2026-10-21); values SkillPatchTable chr_0015_lifeng_* (L12: attacks 0.27 ×2 / 0.65 / 0.79 / 0.39 + 1.13, poise 19, atb 21; finisher 9.0; dive 1.8; battle skill 0.86 ×2 + 2.68, poise 10, phy_resist_down 0.12 for 12 s, 100 SP; combo 1.05 + 3.75, poise 10, usp 10, duration 20, cooldown 15 s; ultimate 4.0 + 4.0 + 6.0, poise 5 each, cost 90). Batch-4 report docs/kit-batches/batch-4/chr_0015_lifeng.md (kit plan and § Kit). No log fixture has Lifeng.

Basic chain attack1 → attack2 → attack3 → attack5 (ComboCacheAction in each file); chr_0015_lifeng_attack4 has SkillPatchTable rows but no SkillData file and isn't in the skill group: unused. attack5's third frame-24 DamageAction (literal-0 scale, mask 0) is left out by the compiler (batch-4 D8c); its SP is the ObtainCostAction once.

Talent 1 (Illumination: ATK per point of Intellect and Will, attributes 78 / 79 = atk_up 0.001 / 0.0015, P3 +0.0005) is the talent's attached passive skill chr_0015_lifeng_talent_1 → buff_chr_0015_lifeng_talent_1, which the stat panel applies (batch-4 D4): nothing in this kit. Talent 2 (Subduer of Evil) and P5 are BuffData handlers, hand-written below (talents' attached buffs with handlers stay kit work, batch-3 D4).

Link: her combo's ComboAction (frame 19, count 1, duration = the combo's `duration`, 20 s) is the trigger combo_link (batch-4 B1: a combo gives no Link by itself). The ultimate's third hit needs a cast that used Link (castLink, batch-4 C1). Open: whether this Link lasts the ComboAction's 20 s or the Link buff's literal 15 s (report U2, in-game test 78).

buffs.label: Turbid Avatar: Physical Susceptibility
buffs.note: buff_chr_0015_lifeng_purify (stackingType 2, max 1): VulnerableAction subType 2 (Physical), rate phy_resist_down (0.12 at L12; P1 +0.05), duration 12 s; child icon buff_chr_0015_lifeng_purify_icon. Created at battle-skill frame 54 before the Knock Down and the slam's DamageAction (triggers turbid_susceptibility*). Logged name assumed as Estella's (buff_common_affixes_vulnerable_physical, the affix VulnerableAction subType 2 makes). Two sources of it at once: in-game test 38's question.

buffs.label: P5: recharging (15 s)
buffs.note: buff_chr_0015_lifeng_potential_5 (attached by P5; lifeType 1, triggerInterval interval 15 s, waitFirstTriggerInterval): its first tick, if talent 2's buff is there, creates buff_chr_0015_lifeng_potential_5_1 and finishes itself (trigger p5_charge).

buffs.label: P5: next talent-2 hit enhanced
buffs.note: buff_chr_0015_lifeng_potential_5_1 (lifeType 1): read and finished by talent 2's handler, which then re-creates buff_chr_0015_lifeng_potential_5 (trigger subduer_of_evil).

triggers.note: CharGrowthTable chr_0015_lifeng_ComboSkill: "COMBO TRIGGER: When the controlled operator performs a Final Strike on an enemy with Physical Susceptibility or Breach." An all-element Susceptibility counts (enemyModifier).

Combo frame 19: ComboAction count 1, duration blackboard `duration` (20 s at every level; SkillPatchTable sub-description "Combo Duration (s) 20"), source self. Description: "grants Link". The Link buff's own literal is 15 s (buff_common_affixes_combo_trigger, useBlackboardKey false): which one the game uses is report U2 (in-game test 78); the kit takes the ComboAction's.

Battle skill frame 54: ForEach target, CheckBuffStackNumByTag (Vulnerable tag 1075718177) compareType 1 (at most) num (0; P1 sets 2) → CreateBuff buff_chr_0015_lifeng_purify, before the KnockDownAction and the DamageAction. The slam's Knock Down always adds a Vulnerable stack below 4, so 'no stacks before' is the stack event from 0 (exact). beforeDamage: the slam takes it (data order; test 51's question). Written as a trigger because a hit's buffs[].if is judged after the hit's own applies.

P1: num = 2 ("no more than 2 Vulnerability stacks"): at most 2 before = at most 3 after a rising stack event (an enemy at 4 adds none: not rising, and it had more than 2). Literal thresholds behind potentialAtLeast (enemyVulnerable takes a literal; batch-3 review's open 'a stack compared with a value').

hits.label: Subduer of Evil: hit on Knock Down
hits.note: buff_chr_0015_lifeng_talent_2 abilityEvent 40 (applying Knock Down), without buff_chr_0015_lifeng_potential_5_1: DamageAction atk_scale_talent2 (0.5 / 1.0 by talent level), damageType 0, no decorate mask (no skill-type bonus), no poise. Logged key assumed: the file holding the DamageAction (report row 27, U4).

hits.label: Subduer of Evil + P5
hits.note: With buff_chr_0015_lifeng_potential_5_1: SimpleCalcBB final_atk_scale_talent2 = atk_scale_talent2 + atk_scale_potential5 (2.5) in one DamageAction, plus a poise unit poise_potential5 (5).

triggers.note: No cooldown in the data (the buff's triggerInterval 1 s has no tick handler). The order matters: the plain hit is judged before p5_ready ends, then the P5 handler's FinishBuff _5_1 and CreateBuff _potential_5. The engine emits physicalStatus for a real Knock Down only (an enemy without Vulnerable just gets a stack: batch-3 P1); abilityEvent 40 isn't 401, so the game may differ (report U1, in-game test 39's variant).

P5 (chr_0015_lifeng_potential_5) attaches buff_chr_0015_lifeng_potential_5 from the start; the first charge after 15 s (waitFirstTriggerInterval). Its tick checks talent 2's buff, so without talent 2 it never charges.

hits.note: Two DamageActions (display_atk_scale = 2 × atk_scale); ObtainCostAction atb × 0.5 each, controlled only (atb 0 otherwise).
Mask 2097280 (Final Strike); poise onlyEnableForMainChar; SP atb 21, controlled only.
BreakingAttackCalculation multiplier 0.1 (mask 132); GainBreakingAttackAtb: the finisher SP is the engine's.
Mask 1152 (dive). Needs mid-air: schedulable once dive attacks are (batch-1 S10); kept for calc.
Frame 54: the Susceptibility check (triggers turbid_susceptibility*), then KnockDownAction (1.5 s, not forced) and the DamageAction (poise), then buff_common_obtain_ultimate_sp (teamEnergy).

skills.label: Combo skill: Aspect of Wrath
skills.note: ComboAction at frame 19 gives Link (trigger combo_link). TimeDilation curve ComboSkill from SkillData. buff_chr_0015_lifeng_combo_skill_tutorial_marker (f48) is tutorial only.

skills.label: Ultimate: Heart of the Unmoving
skills.note: Time stop (UltimateTimeAction 0–56) from SkillData. SpawnAbilityEntity at 58: chr_0015_lifeng_ultimate_skill_abentity (its frames + 58). At its frame 67 (cast frame 125): if isCombo = 0, JumpToAction 150 (skips the third hit); else EntityBB_isCombo = 0. isCombo is copied at cast frames 1–3 from EntityBB_isCombo, which buff_chr_0015_lifeng_passive sets to 1 when buff_common_affixes_skillimbue_atk (the Link this cast used) is added to her (abilityEvent 9), and to 0 on abilityEvent 31. Event keys: the entity file holds all three DamageActions, so never chr_0015_lifeng_ultimate_skill (which ZMDLogs uses for Valiant's hit, wpn_lance_0010).

hits.note: Entity frame 6: KnockDownAction (2.1 s, not forced), PullAction, DamageAction mask 4608.
Entity frame 121, only if the cast used a Link ("If the skill consumes a Link, then it deals an additional hit of massive Physical DMG"): castLink, judged from the hit's own cast.
